description: Compare nutrients side-by-side for 2–5 foods. Returns a structured table — one row per nutrient, one column per food — formatted as markdown. Best for "spinach vs kale iron" or "which has more protein?" questions. Omit nutrients[] to use the 12 most common defaults (energy, protein, fat, saturated fat, carbs, fiber, sugars, sodium, potassium, calcium, iron, vitamin C); provide nutrients[] with specific FDC IDs to compare different nutrients. All values are scaled to the same gram basis (default 100g). If one or more FDC IDs are not found, the comparison proceeds with the valid foods — only throws too_few_foods when fewer than 2 IDs return data.

fdcIds.description: FDC IDs to compare — 2 to 5 foods. Use usda_search_foods to discover IDs.

nutrients.description: Nutrient IDs to include in the comparison. Defaults to the 12 most common: energy (1008), protein (1003), total fat (1004), saturated fat (1258), carbohydrate (1005), fiber (1079), total sugars (2000), sodium (1093), potassium (1092), calcium (1087), iron (1089), vitamin C (1162). Use usda_list_nutrients to look up other IDs.

quantity.description: Gram basis for comparison. All values scaled to this amount. Must be positive. Default 100.

unit.description: Unit for quantity. Default "g". Does not support "serving" (use a fixed gram basis for consistent comparison).

name: usda_compare_foods

basis.description: The common scaling basis applied to all nutrient values.

gramWeight.description: Gram weight resolved from quantity+unit — all nutrient values are per this many grams.

quantity.description: Numeric quantity provided in the request.

unit.description: Unit provided in the request (g, oz, lb, or kg).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `too_few_foods`: Fewer than 2 of the provided FDC IDs returned data, making comparison impossible. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

foods.description: The compared foods, in the same order as the values arrays below.

dataType.description: FDC data source: SR Legacy, Foundation, Survey (FNDDS), or Branded.

missingData.description: Foods or food+nutrient pairs where data was unavailable. Absent when all data was present.

items.description: A food or food+nutrient pair where data was unavailable.

fdcId.description: FDC ID that had missing data.

nutrientId.description: Nutrient ID that was missing, or null when the entire food was not found.

nutrients.description: Nutrient rows — one entry per requested nutrient, with per-food values in the values[] array.

items.description: One nutrient row with per-food values.

values.description: One value per food in the same order as foods[]. null when data is unavailable for that food.

title: Compare USDA Foods
